name: skills
title_zh: 71 个技能一包带走，装完不占脑子
tagline_zh: 别人按需装单个，你一次拿全 71 个。省去挨个搜、挨个试、挨个配的功夫，装完即用，不折腾。
tagline_en: Stop hunting skills one by one. Get all 71 at once, ready to use. No endless searching, testing, configuring.
why_zh: 一个仓库打包 71 个技能，装一次等于别人装 71 次。适合想先囤货、再按需挑的探索型用户。
why_en: One repo, 71 skills. One install equals 71 installs. Perfect for explorers who want to stock up first, then pick as needed.
limit_zh: 只负责安装，不保证每个技能都好用。71 个里可能只有 10 个对你有用，其余 61 个纯占空间。装完得自己逐个试错。
limit_en: Installs all, curates none. Maybe 10 of 71 fit you; the rest just sit there. You must trial and discard each yourself.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 71 skills in one pack, installed and forgotten
